Hi Alex / EnerFlow team —

Thanks for the momentum during last week's demo. Per our mutual action plan (MAP) ask, I'm kicking off a short evidence-handling alignment thread so we can map owners, evidence lanes, and a proposed close timeline for the SOC2 evaluation. Attached is a first-pass worksheet that breaks the MAP into evidence lanes and suggested owners.

Quick context: Redwood will be supporting the SOC2 evaluation with a combination of documented artifacts and live evidence collection. To avoid bottlenecks we want 1-2 named POCs on your side for GRC and data handling, and an internal roster of lane owners so we can hand off specific evidence requests directly.

Proposed internal owners (from our side):
- Laura Bennett — GRC / evidence owner (will shepherd access control, roles/permissions, and SOC2 control narratives)
- Karthik Iyer — Technical evidence / logging & telemetry owner (will coordinate logs, retention, and ingestion proofs)
- Rafael Mendes — Commercial / timeline owner (contracts, SLAs, procurement touches)

Action items for EnerFlow: please confirm the two POCs (GRC + Data Handling) and indicate any internal lanes you want us to own end-to-end. If possible, share any pre-existing SOC2 scoping docs.

Next step: can we schedule a 30-minute alignment slot this week? I have availability Wed 3/24 10:00-11:30 PT or Thu 3/25 08:30-11:00 PT. Rafael will coordinate once we have a confirmed POC list.

I can take the Thu 3/25 09:00 PT alignment call. Vanessa / Rafael — if you can confirm the meeting invite, I'll use that call to walk Priya and Sam through the request packets and expected timelines.
